# hivelocity_vps_volume (Data Source)

Looks up a VPS volume, for example by `device_id` and `type`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_vps_volume" "root" {
  filter {
    name   = "device_id"
    values = ["12345"]
  }
  filter {
    name   = "type"
    values = ["ROOT"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the volume was created.
- `device_id` (Number) VPS instance the volume is attached to.
- `facility_code` (String) Facility of the volume.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `size` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `type` (String) `ROOT` or `DATADISK`.
- `volume_id` (String) Unique ID of the volume.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
